title.en: Show every Play activity from the main menu
title.zh: 主菜单进入边玩边学时显示全部玩法

purpose.en: Fix the Play menu entry so it uses the interface language as the default learning language and never hides five activities when no language query is present.
purpose.zh: 修复边玩边学菜单入口：用当前界面语言作为默认学习语言，不再因缺少语言参数而隐藏五种玩法。

en: Send the shared Play menu and the home Today task image to the Play page with the current interface language selected.
Render all six Play activity tiles for direct links with or without a valid language query.
Keep the twelve-language picker visible below the activities so the learner can change the target language.
zh: 共享导航中的边玩边学链接和首页今日任务图片都会携带当前界面语言。
无论直接链接是否包含有效语言参数，边玩边学都会显示全部六张玩法卡片。
十二种语言选择区持续显示在玩法下方，方便用户切换目标语言。

en: Default /zh/play to Chinese and /en/play to English when no valid learning-language query is supplied.
Build Smart Card, Challenge, Free Trial, Rankings, and Redeem links from the selected or default language without conditional tile removal.
Keep Today’s Sprint language and duration selection, scoring, sign-in, and reward boundaries unchanged.
zh: 当未提供有效学习语言参数时，/zh/play 默认中文，/en/play 默认英语。
智慧卡、挑战、免费试学、排行榜和兑换链接统一使用选中或默认语言，不再按条件删除卡片。
今日速成的语言与时间选择、评分、登录和奖励边界保持不变。

en: TypeScript, changed-file ESLint, sensitive-data scan, and the production build pass.
The full repository suite passes after updating the intentional Course-before-College contract.
WebKit runtime layout passes 260/260 checks across 26 routes, Chinese and English, and five phone, iPad, and desktop viewports.
Shared policy, architecture, base-feature consistency, and all 11 SmartLingo shared contracts pass.
zh: TypeScript、本次文件 ESLint、敏感数据扫描和正式构建通过。
更新明确的课程先于学院合同后，全仓测试通过。
WebKit 运行布局通过 260/260 项：26 个路由、中英文和 5 种手机、iPad、桌面尺寸。
共享政策、架构、基础功能一致性及 SmartLingo 全部 11 项共享合同通过。

en: Automated production browser QA cannot provide a real human speech sample; it verifies navigation and the microphone-ready state without inventing a pronunciation score.
zh: 自动正式站浏览器验收无法提供真人语音样本；它会验证导航与麦克风就绪状态，但不会伪造发音成绩。

en: This release changes SmartLingo learning discovery only and does not alter other portfolio sites or their navigation.
zh: 本次只调整 SmartLingo 学习入口，不改变其他站点及其导航。
